name: Elite eFibo Trader
summary: This EA trades Fibonacci retracement levels in the direction of the prevailing trend, entering positions when price pulls back to key Fibonacci zones. It uses trend identification combined with Fibonacci level validation to generate entry signals, and manages exits through Fibonacci extension targets or trailing stops. The strategy aims to capture trend continuation moves after corrective pullbacks.
summary_zh: 该EA在当前趋势方向上交易斐波那契回撤水平，当价格回调至关键斐波那契区域时开仓。它结合趋势识别与斐波那契水平验证来生成入场信号，并通过斐波那契扩展目标或追踪止损管理出场。该策略旨在捕捉修正回调后的趋势延续行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于斐波那契回撤交易，即在已确立的趋势中等待价格回调至关键斐波那契水平（如38.2%、50%、61.8%）时入场，顺应主趋势方向交易。入场条件要求首先确认趋势方向，通常通过移动平均线或其他趋势指标判断，然后等待价格回撤至指定的斐波那契回撤位并出现反转信号后进场。出场条件包括价格达到斐波那契扩展目标位（如161.8%或261.8%）获利了结，或触及止损位退出。仓位管理通常采用固定手数或基于账户余额的百分比计算方式，部分版本支持根据斐波那契水平调整仓位大小。资金管理方面，EA设置止损以控制单笔风险，但具体止损比例和风险敞口控制取决于参数配置的严谨程度。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Fibonacci retracement trading, entering positions in the direction of the established trend when price pulls back to key Fibonacci levels such as 38.2%, 50%, or 61.8%. Entry conditions require first confirming the trend direction, typically through moving averages or other trend indicators, then waiting for price to retrace to a specified Fibonacci level and show a reversal signal before entering. Exit conditions include taking profit at Fibonacci extension targets like 161.8% or 261.8%, or exiting at a defined stop loss level. Position sizing typically uses either fixed lot sizes or percentage-based calculations relative to account balance, with some versions adjusting position size based on which Fibonacci level is entered. Money management involves setting stop losses to control per-trade risk, though the rigor of stop loss ratios and overall exposure control depends on the parameter configuration quality.

pros: 斐波那契回撤策略逻辑清晰，入场点位有技术分析依据，符合趋势跟踪的顺势交易原则
利用趋势方向过滤信号，避免逆势交易，降低了假突破带来的亏损风险
设置了明确的止损和止盈规则，风险可控，且追踪止损有助于锁定利润
参数可配置性强，交易者可以根据不同品种和时间周期调整斐波那契水平和仓位大小
pros_en: Fibonacci retracement strategy has clear logic with entry points backed by technical analysis, following the trend trading principle
Trend direction filter avoids counter-trend trades, reducing loss risk from false breakouts
Defined stop loss and take profit rules provide controllable risk, and trailing stop helps lock in profits
Highly configurable parameters allow traders to adjust Fibonacci levels and position sizing for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 依赖趋势判断的准确性，在震荡行情中可能频繁发出错误信号导致连续亏损
斐波那契水平的有效性存在主观性，不同交易者可能选择不同的回撤位作为入场点
缺乏对市场波动率和点差的过滤机制，在高波动或高点差环境下可能产生不利成交
止损设置可能不够灵活，固定点数止损在不同波动率环境下效果差异较大
cons_en: Depends on accuracy of trend identification; frequent false signals and consecutive losses may occur in ranging markets
Fibonacci level validity is subjective, as different traders may choose different retracement levels for entry
Lacks volatility and spread filtering mechanisms, potentially resulting in unfavorable fills in high-volatility or high-spread environments
Stop loss settings may lack flexibility, as fixed-pip stops perform very differently under varying volatility conditions
improvements: 增加ADX或波动率过滤器，在震荡行情中自动暂停交易以减少虚假信号
引入动态止损机制，根据ATR指标自动调整止损距离以适应不同市场波动率
improvements_en: Add ADX or volatility filter to automatically pause trading during ranging markets, reducing false signals
Introduce dynamic stop loss mechanism using ATR indicator to automatically adjust stop distance for varying market volatility

risk_points: 在震荡行情中趋势判断可能失效，导致逆势或频繁交易亏损
固定点数止损可能在大波动行情中不足以覆盖正常波动，造成过早止损或止损过小
risk_points_en: Trend identification may fail in ranging markets, leading to counter-trend or frequent trading losses
Fixed-pip stop loss may be insufficient during high volatility, causing premature stops or inadequate protection

The strategy aims to capture trend continuation moves after corrective pullbacks.
